digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Monday, August 17, with five working blocks, three immediate availability constraints, three urgent items, and eight carry-overs. The day turns on completing the Amazon Connect WBS and RAID package by 4:00 PM ET for Tuesday's SaltClick leadership meeting, protecting Salesforce coverage while Sara, Nadia, Mar, and Shannon have limited availability, and converting the incident-response trigger work into one owner map after Tuesday's submissions. The new Service Cloud Voice plan is now shared, but UAT, phone-number provisioning, manual wave configuration, and ownership dates remain the clearest delivery risk. Repository state was last modified Friday morning, so carry-over completion may lag the live dashboard.

items.label: Finish the Amazon Connect leadership package
items.detail: Complete the WBS and RAID updates by 4:00 PM ET so Tuesday's SaltClick leadership meeting has one current operating view. Confirm owners, dates, the production work breakdown, daily update cadence, and the forecast now being added to the newly shared Service Cloud Voice plan.

items.label: Unblock Amazon Connect UAT and reset readiness
items.detail: UAT items remain open, the 1,600-phone-number request is still in progress, and the proposed large wave creates manual-configuration and failure-management risk. Lock the tester coverage, voicemail and access fixes, remaining queue setup, wave sizing, and a credible revised UAT date.

items.label: Name owners for this week's coverage gaps
items.detail: Sara and Nadia are out today, Mar is unavailable through 1:00 PM, and Shannon is expected to be out through the week. Confirm who covers Revenue and Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Amazon Connect decisions, and any portfolio escalation that cannot wait.

items.label: Close the Re-Open Cases SOP and handoff path
items.detail: Confirm when Leo will return the requested SOP feedback and set the final due date. Gustavo is expected to be able to exit the project within a week after the feedback arrives.

items.label: Terminar Hoja de Jorge
items.detail: Use the noon focus block to finish the sheet so it is ready for the next UAT and portfolio discussion.

items.label: Submit the Spencer Huffman interview feedback
items.detail: Send the Project Manager III assessment so the hiring process is no longer waiting on Jean's response.

items.label: Review the Supabase security alert
items.detail: Verify the affected project and severity, then assign remediation without assuming it is the same issue previously closed.

items.label: Decide the home for CSC/LC Green Approval
items.detail: Confirm whether the intake returns to PMO as a standard project and name the owner so it does not remain between portfolios.

items.detail: Approve timecards, review the reduced coverage plan, and send any ownership asks before the first sync.

items.detail: Finish the Amazon Connect leadership package and Jorge's sheet before the afternoon portfolio sequence.

items.label: 2:00-3:30 PM - BD review and Maria 1:1
items.detail: Use the BD Portfolio Review to rank dependencies, then carry the owners and roadblocks directly into the 3:00 PM conversation with Maria.

items.label: Set the Security Technology Launch path
items.detail: Jean was assigned the new firmwide physical-security intake. Confirm the Workplace Services and IT scoping group, sponsor path, first milestone, and the Salt Lake City deployment sequence needed before the end of September.

items.detail: Bucket owners owe their trigger and notification workflows by Tuesday, August 18. Set the consolidation format now so Jean can map each bucket to its trigger contact and communication path immediately after submissions arrive.
